out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Paper towels were not observed at the hand sink by the 3 compartment sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC PLACE PAPER TOWELS AT THIS SINK. ALL HAND SINKS MUST HAVE PAPER TOWELS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIA solution was measured over 400 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food- contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: PIC REMADE THE QUATERNARY AMMONIA SOLUTION. UPON TESTING, QUATERNARY AMMONIA SOLUTION WAS OBSERVED AT 200ppm.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC TO RENEW HIS CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER CERTIFICATE. PLEASE CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: 1) prepared grilled cheese sandwiches were observed being stored for more than 7 days.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE GRILLED CHEESE SANDWICHES.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: A chlorine test kit was not observed in the facility.
violations.corrective_action: PURCHASE A CHLORINE TEST KIT/TEST STRIPS
